content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

I can only recommend the new smartphone XYZ-123 to everyone. Of course the camera could be better, as it only has mediocre resolution and images in dark surroundings are often snowy. But for snap shots that's still enough.
What is the relation between "Of course the camera could be better," and "But for snap shots that's still enough." from the above essay? Choose from following options 1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
